name: Another Zen Card
description: A solid, glass-free theme: fixed palettes instead of the workspace gradient, the page and toolbar as one outlined card, and the accent kept for a few small touches.

card-tint.uc.js.name: Card helpers
card-tint.uc.js.description: Colors the toolbar from the top of the page, shows only the domain in the centered address bar, cross-fades the Library, moves the window buttons into the sidebar-only layout's top row, opens extension popups from the Extensions button, and themes the settings dialogs.

author: TaouMou
